title: Inbox Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inbox:metric1
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day inbox metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on inbox metric1 (1) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It combines what time of day your inbox metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
